metadata.core_finding: Zero reachable writes to JobStatus.PARTIAL exist across the codebase. All existing durable worker handlers process single entities/windows and transition directly to SUCCEEDED or FAILED/DEAD_LETTER/RETRYING.

canonical_vocabulary.orthogonal_boundary: JobStatus represents business outcome; JobDeliveryState represents transport delivery mechanics. Terminal JobStatus must have null delivery_state.

default_worker_registry_jobs.delivery_state_handling: Transport retry (RETRYING) up to 3 attempts, then DEAD_LETTER on terminal failure.
default_worker_registry_jobs.partial_assessment: Inapplicable for canonical PARTIAL in current single-store design because each job evaluates a single store's forecast without independent sub-item aggregates.

default_worker_registry_jobs.delivery_state_handling: Scheduler backoff and circuit breaker, queue RETRYING/DEAD_LETTER.
default_worker_registry_jobs.partial_assessment: Data-level partial candidate (accepted vs quarantined records), but currently executed as a single provider/window job returning SUCCEEDED or FAILED at the queue layer without JobStatus.PARTIAL or item-level retry.

default_worker_registry_jobs.delivery_state_handling: Stage-level error handling, NonRetryableJobError fails job to DEAD_LETTER.
default_worker_registry_jobs.partial_assessment: Inapplicable for canonical PARTIAL as-is because it processes a single listing intake through sequential stages. If any unrecoverable error occurs, the single intake fails.

synchronous_partial_operations_not_durab.receipt_structure: BatchIntakeReceipt (accepted_count, rejected_count, items array with ACCEPTED/REJECTED status)
synchronous_partial_operations_not_durab.notes: True business partial outcome, but currently synchronous API command execution without durable queue dispatch or JobStatus.
Partial commit of valid rows during XLSX upload; synchronous command with idempotency replay, not a durable queue job.
Data quality partitioning at domain persistence level; scheduler job level remains SUCCEEDED or FAILED.

module_worker_entrypoints_inventory.current_aggregate_behavior: Evaluates items sequentially; returns status='succeeded' on completion, raises on error.
Generates reports per candidate; warnings are domain notices, not failure items; returns status='succeeded'.
Domain service returning single forecast result; returns status='succeeded'.
Calculates scores + warnings; domain state PARTIALLY_ABSORBED is spatial density state, not job status; returns status='succeeded'.
Runs scenario solver; returns 'succeeded' or 'completed_with_infeasible' (domain outcome).
Hard constraint checking; fail-fast aggregate failure, no partial transition.
Returns geocoded coordinates + warnings; returns status='succeeded'.
Sweeps matured_ids/pending_ids/evaluated_ids partition lists; returns SUCCEEDED.
Sweeps expired surveys and marks status; returns expired_count.
Saga evaluation / monitoring drift assessment; returns MonitoringEvaluation with drifted_columns.

candidate_jobs_for_durable_partial_promo.name: batch-listing-intake
candidate_jobs_for_durable_partial_promo.business_benefit: Allows large multi-listing uploads (100+ listings) to run asynchronously with itemized progress, durable partial completion, and retry for transient failures without re-uploading valid listings.
typical_failure_scenarios: Missing mandatory address on row 4 (non-retryable input error)
Downstream geocoding timeout on row 12 (retryable transient error)
Duplicate external listing ID on row 25 (non-retryable business rejection)
candidate_jobs_for_durable_partial_promo.architectural_fit: High. Business already has 207 Multi-Status per-row receipts in sync API; promotes existing pattern to durable background queue.

candidate_jobs_for_durable_partial_promo.name: multi-partition-external-fetch
candidate_jobs_for_durable_partial_promo.business_benefit: Enables scheduled external fetches across multiple geographic regions or provider partitions in one job, recording PARTIAL when one provider endpoint fails while others succeed.
typical_failure_scenarios: Provider API 503 for Region A while Region B and C succeed
Schema parse error on specific feed payload partition
Rate limit quota exceeded on secondary provider
candidate_jobs_for_durable_partial_promo.architectural_fit: Medium. Requires redesign of ExternalFetchScheduler from single-provider tick to multi-partition job payload.

candidate_jobs_for_durable_partial_promo.name: batch-sitescore-evaluation
candidate_jobs_for_durable_partial_promo.business_benefit: Evaluates 20+ store candidates in one durable job; partial score completion allows operator to inspect succeeded candidate scores while investigating failed candidates.
typical_failure_scenarios: Candidate coordinates outside valid territorial boundary
Underlying demographic cell data missing for candidate 7
Solver timeout on dense urban trade area optimization
candidate_jobs_for_durable_partial_promo.architectural_fit: Medium. Operator UI already has SiteScoreJobStatus component displaying PARTIAL state.
